requirements.requirement: Seed-starting tray of at least four cells
requirements.evidence: 4 full hex bases at 0,0,0 ; 1,0,0 ; 0,1,0 ; 1,-1,0 forming a compact cluster

requirements.requirement: Each cell with a draining bin
requirements.evidence: bins bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,-1,0~hex-bin-full-drain — all variant hex-bin-full-drain (drained floor), each filled with soil and planted

finish.summary: Built 4-cell hex cluster, each cell fitted with hex-bin-full-drain drained bin, soil-filled and planted (seedlings visible from above), caps and joint bolts applied. Check clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your four-cell seed tray is on the way — I'll assemble draining bins for each spot.
